sources.label: Pro Game Guides - All Wands, Hats & Potions in Wizard Alchemy
AllThings.How - Wizard Alchemy Wands, Hats, Robes and Potions Reference

items.name: Twisted Wand
items.sourceLocation: Given to all players at the start
items.progressionUse: Starter damage only; replace it once a shop wand is affordable.
items.verificationNote: Confirmed by Pro Game Guides, Gamezebo, and Beebom tier sources. No reliable individual image found.

items.name: Wingbird Wand
items.progressionUse: First cheap upgrade when starter damage feels too low.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Gamezebo, and AllThings.How list 200 Gold; Pro Game Guides lists 300 Gold.

items.name: Azure Wand
items.progressionUse: Early farming upgrade before the 8,000 Gold Demon Trident jump.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer and AllThings.How list 500 Gold; Pro Game Guides and Gamezebo list 1,000 Gold.

items.name: Demon Trident Wand
items.progressionUse: Best mid-game value before hidden and late-game wand prices.
items.verificationNote: All checked stat sources agree on 8,000 Gold, 30 Attack, and +15% Attack Bonus.

items.name: Ice Star Wand
items.sourceLocation: Hidden purchase inside the waterfall cave near the starting village
items.progressionUse: Strong cooldown-focused option once spell recasts matter more than raw basic damage.
items.verificationNote: Sources agree on core stats. Location descriptions disagree on left or right wording, so the dataset uses the stable waterfall cave description.

items.name: Ember Staff Wand
items.sourceLocation: Hidden purchase on the treehouse branch near the waterfall
items.progressionUse: Highest raw Attack among the verified wands and a strong boss-farming target.
items.verificationNote: Sources agree on cost and stats. Directional wording around the treehouse differs, so the dataset avoids left/right wording.

items.name: Ember Wand
items.sourceLocation: Top of the Volcano in the Sea of Oblivion region
items.progressionUse: Late Sea of Oblivion option for players who want bonus stacking over the Ember Staff's higher raw Attack.
items.verificationNote: Found on BloxInformer's New Mainland update page. Older PGG, Gamezebo, Beebom, and AllThings.How sources do not include this wand.
